summary: The LLM landscape as of early 2025 is dominated by OpenAI's GPT family in commercial API usage, while Meta's Llama models lead open-source downloads and self-hosted deployments. A diverse ecosystem has emerged with strong challengers from Google, Anthropic, Mistral, and DeepSeek, reflecting both closed-API and open-weight adoption patterns across developer surveys and platform statistics.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Consistently ranked #1 in developer API usage; OpenAI reported over 100 million weekly active users on ChatGPT and GPT-4o dominates Stack Overflow 2024 AI tool surveys as the most-used LLM API.
models.best_for: General-purpose enterprise and developer applications requiring multimodal capabilities

models.name: Llama 3.1 / Llama 3.2 (family)
models.popularity_notes: Llama models collectively account for the highest HuggingFace download volumes of any model family, with hundreds of millions of downloads and the largest self-hosted developer base globally.
strengths: Fully open weights enabling local deployment
Strong benchmark performance at its weight class
models.best_for: Self-hosted deployments, fine-tuning for domain-specific tasks, cost-sensitive applications

models.name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
models.popularity_notes: Anthropic's Claude 3.5 Sonnet ranked as the top-preferred model for coding tasks in multiple 2024 developer surveys and saw rapid enterprise API adoption, with Anthropic reporting significant revenue growth driven by this model.
strengths: Top-tier coding and software engineering performance
Strong instruction following and nuanced reasoning
Low hallucination rate on factual tasks
200K context window for large document analysis
models.best_for: Complex coding tasks, long-document analysis, enterprise workflows requiring high accuracy

models.name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: Gemini 1.5 Pro is the most-used model in Google's AI ecosystem with over 1.5 million developers using the Gemini API per Google I/O 2024 announcements, ranking highly in JetBrains 2024 developer surveys.
strengths: Largest context window among major commercial models (1M tokens)
Native multimodal (text, image, video, audio, code)
Deep Google Workspace and Cloud integration
models.best_for: Applications requiring extremely long context, video/audio understanding, and Google Cloud integration

models.name: GPT-3.5 Turbo
models.popularity_notes: Despite newer models, GPT-3.5 Turbo retains massive legacy usage due to its low cost and remains one of the highest API call volume models per OpenAI usage data and third-party analytics platforms like usage.ai.
models.best_for: High-volume, cost-sensitive applications such as chatbots, classification, and summarization

models.name: Mistral Large / Mistral family
models.popularity_notes: Mistral models rank among the top downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and Mistral's API saw rapid European enterprise adoption, with Mistral 7B being one of the most-downloaded models of 2024 on HuggingFace.
models.best_for: European enterprises, multilingual applications, and efficient self-hosted deployments

models.name: DeepSeek-V3 / DeepSeek-R1
models.popularity_notes: DeepSeek-R1 became one of the fastest-growing models on HuggingFace in early 2025 with millions of downloads within weeks of release, and DeepSeek's app briefly topped App Store charts globally in January 2025.
strengths: Exceptional cost efficiency vs. performance ratio
Competitive with GPT-4 class models at fraction of cost
models.best_for: Cost-efficient reasoning, mathematics, coding, and research applications

models.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash
models.popularity_notes: Gemini 2.0 Flash achieved rapid adoption as Google's recommended default API model for speed-sensitive applications, with Google reporting it as the most-called model in the Gemini API by request volume shortly after launch.
strengths: Extremely low cost with very fast latency
Strong performance for its price tier
models.best_for: High-volume, latency-sensitive production applications needing multimodal support at low cost

models.name: Qwen2.5 (family)
models.popularity_notes: Qwen2.5 models became among the top-10 most downloaded model families on HuggingFace in late 2024, with particularly strong adoption across Asian developer markets and strong benchmark results driving community uptake.
strengths: Strong multilingual capabilities especially for Asian languages
Full open-weight release across multiple sizes (0.5B to 72B)
Active HuggingFace community with many fine-tunes
models.best_for: Multilingual applications, Asian language support, and open-source fine-tuning projects

models.name: Grok-2
models.popularity_notes: Grok-2 gained measurable developer adoption following its API launch in late 2024 and integration into X (Twitter), with xAI reporting growing API usage and Grok appearing in emerging developer tool surveys by end of 2024.
strengths: Real-time access to X (Twitter) data and web information
Less restrictive content policies for certain use cases
Growing API ecosystem with competitive pricing
models.best_for: Real-time social media data analysis, current events applications, and research requiring up-to-date information
